rationale: TLR4-MD-2 is the only receptor for LPS here, so an antibody that blocks it leaves nothing to signal through and TNF never rises above the unstimulated baseline. Polymyxin B gets to the same place from the other side by sequestering lipid A. CD14 only matters when ligand is scarce, and 100 ng/ml is far from scarce, so that arm sits on top of the reference. Interferon-gamma priming adds receptor rather than a second stimulus, so the same dose drives a larger response.
